name: Global Now Pte. Ltd.
india_angle: Global Now Pte. Ltd. is expanding its presence in India, focusing on energy-efficient manufacturing solutions for the semiconductor sector.
summary: Global Now Pte. Ltd. is a global trading firm specializing in the distribution of electrical components and semiconductor equipment. The company is expanding into energy-efficient manufacturing solutions, providing tailored support to semiconductor manufacturers. With operations in multiple countries, they are committed to quality and innovation in the semiconductor industry.
